event_summary: A metal knife blade moves into a green leafy herb pile on a wooden cutting surface, while loose leaves and stems become spread around the blade.
raw_event_description: At the start, a dense green leafy herb pile rests on a wooden cutting surface, with blurred garlic and yellow citrus pieces in the background. A shiny metal knife blade then becomes visible near the herb pile and moves into the leaves. As the blade passes through the herbs, leaves and stems shift, bend, and appear as separated loose pieces on the board, especially to the left and front of the main pile. The camera remains close to the board with a shallow-focus view.

reasons: The herb pile and cutting surface are visible at the beginning.
The knife blade is not yet clearly visible in the first frame.
